raw_definitions: Definisi : n peniup seruling; ( of bagpipes ) peniup begpaip: a lone ~ played a melancholy air , seorang peniup begpaip memainkan lagu sedih; he who pays the ~ ( calls the tune ), siapa yg membayar dialah yg berhak (membuat penentuan); pay the ~ , yg membayar: as he was paying the ~, it was only natural that he was in charge of the whole expedition , oleh sebab dia yg membayar, sudah wajarlah dia yg mengendalikan keseluruhan ekspedisi itu. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
